svg.title: RoPE per-frequency relative phase wrap
svg.desc: Two schematic two-dimensional RoPE frequency pairs use pi over two and pi over ten radians per relative position. At an offset of four the fast phase wraps fully while the slow phase is only seventy-two degrees. The full model has many frequencies; this is an analytic toy phase example, not quality or context-length measurement.

g.text: Same relative offset · different phase speeds
